title: Interleaved entropy coders
relevance: Foundational paper showing that ANS/entropy coder streams can be interleaved without metadata overhead, enabling superscalar and SIMD decoding.

title: Entropy coding in Oodle Data: Huffman coding
relevance: Detailed practical guide to multi-stream Huffman decoder design, including table layout, bit I/O, and ILP optimization for x86.

title: Entropy decoding in Oodle Data: x86-64 3-stream Huffman decoders
relevance: Implementation details for 3-stream Huffman decoders on generic x86-64, including register allocation and micro-op scheduling.

title: Fast Computation of Huffman Codes
relevance: Branch-free Huffman code computation techniques from Intel, reducing branch misprediction overhead in table construction.
